target: The segmentation target is the visible liver parenchyma in an abdominal ultrasound image.
appearance: Liver parenchyma has a patient-specific granular echotexture and variable brightness in hepatobiliary ultrasound.
boundary: Follow the visible hepatic capsule and the contour separating liver parenchyma from surrounding tissue.
exclusion: Exclude the gallbladder lumen and wall, kidney, bowel, abdominal wall and background outside the visible liver.
domain_identity: Two-dimensional hepatobiliary ultrasound of the liver parenchyma.
